tasks.title: Tree-wide sweep classifier: sweep_modules -> SweepReport
acceptance_criteria: harness/wire_up.py exposes a dataclass SweepReport and a function sweep_modules(repo_root, *, roots) -> SweepReport
sweep_modules builds the import graph once and partitions source modules into WIRED / CONFIG_WIRED / ORPHAN_CLUSTER / ORPHAN
tests/harness/test_sweep_classifier.py passes and tests/harness/test_live_root_reconciliation.py + tests/harness/test_wire_up.py still pass
tasks.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only sweep classifier to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py: a dataclass SweepReport and a function sweep_modules(repo_root, *, roots) that builds the intra-project import graph ONCE and partitions every source module into exactly one of WIRED / CONFIG_WIRED / ORPHAN_CLUSTER / ORPHAN.

spec.objective: Add a pure, stdlib-only sweep classifier to the EXISTING module harness/wire_up.py: a dataclass SweepReport and a function sweep_modules(repo_root, *, roots) that builds the intra-project import graph ONCE and partitions every source module into exactly one of WIRED / CONFIG_WIRED / ORPHAN_CLUSTER / ORPHAN.
functional_requirements: Add a @dataclass SweepReport with fields: wired: list[str], config_wired: list[str], orphan_cluster: list[str], orphan: list[str], roots: list[str]. Add a method to_dict(self) -> dict returning the four class lists keyed 'wired','config_wired','orphan_cluster','orphan'. Add a method to_markdown(self) -> str rendering a deterministic markdown report whose section headers contain the class names (WIRED, CONFIG_WIRED, ORPHAN_CLUSTER, ORPHAN) and which lists each class's sorted members.
Add a function sweep_modules(repo_root, *, roots) -> SweepReport.

Build the import graph ONCE via harness.rebuild.discover.module_import_graph(Path(repo_root), modules) where modules,_,_ = discover_modules(Path(repo_root)). Do NOT call check_wired per module (that rebuilds the graph each time -- O(n^2)).

Source set = the discovered non-test modules MINUS any whose POSIX rel-path starts with one of: '_archive/', '_autowork_archive/', 'samples/', 'scripts/', 'tests/', 'venv/'. Only source-set modules are classified; the FULL non-test module list is still used to build the graph and the importer map.
Compute the reachable set by BFS forward from the `roots` that exist in the module set, following graph edges. Compute importers[d] = {m : d in graph[m]} over the full graph.

Classify each source module m in priority order: (1) if m is in the reachable set -> WIRED; (2) else if _grep_config(Path(repo_root), Path(m).stem) is truthy (config-string wiring) -> CONFIG_WIRED; (3) else if importers.get(m) is non-empty (inbound importers exist but none reachable) -> ORPHAN_CLUSTER; (4) else -> ORPHAN.
Each SweepReport class list is sorted; roots holds the sorted seeded roots. sweep_modules is deterministic (same inputs -> identical SweepReport).

Pure: stdlib only (dataclasses, collections deque/defaultdict, pathlib). No process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess; only filesystem reads via discover + _grep_config. Do NOT write any file (the markdown is returned by to_markdown(), not written here).
spec.interfaces: @dataclass SweepReport(wired: list[str], config_wired: list[str], orphan_cluster: list[str], orphan: list[str], roots: list[str]) with to_dict() -> dict and to_markdown() -> str. sweep_modules(repo_root, *, roots) -> SweepReport. Lives in harness/wire_up.py beside the unchanged LIVE_ROOTS / WireResult / check_wired / _grep_config / discover_live_roots seams. Consumes harness.rebuild.discover.discover_modules and module_import_graph unchanged.
edge_cases: A module imported ONLY by a test file is ORPHAN: the graph is built over the non-test module list, so test importers never appear and never launder it.
A module reachable from a root is WIRED even if some of its other importers are excluded archive/sample modules.
A module with inbound importers that are themselves unreachable is ORPHAN_CLUSTER, NOT plain ORPHAN.
Excluded-directory modules (_archive/**, samples/**, scripts/**, tests/**, venv/**) appear in NO class list even if they import or are imported by source modules.
config_wired is only consulted when the module is not reachable, so a reachable module referenced in config is still WIRED, not CONFIG_WIRED.
non_goals: No change to LIVE_ROOTS, WireResult, check_wired, _grep_config, or discover_live_roots -- this leaf ADDS SweepReport + sweep_modules only.
No file writes, no MCP/network/process/model calls -- pure stdlib over discover + filesystem reads.
No reimplementation of module_import_graph or discover_modules.
No MCP cross-check and no regression-guard test -- those are separate downstream leaves.

unit_tests: WIRED class holds reachable modules and roots
ORPHAN_CLUSTER holds modules with unreachable inbound importers
test-only importer does not launder an orphan
class lists sorted and classification deterministic
test_spec.test_data_requirements: A hermetic tmp source tree (root + wired + orphan + cluster pair + config-referenced + test-imported module + excluded dirs) supplied by the committed oracle.
